title: Muxed-account strkey with the largest muxed id, 2^64-1
why: The muxed id is an unsigned 64-bit value; readers that hold it in a signed or floating-point type change it, and the SEP's vectors stop at 2^63.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/strkey/synthetic-gap-vectors.muxed-id-2-pow-64-minus-1.json. The text was encoded from the stated payload with an independent SEP-0023 encoder (version byte, payload, CRC16-XModem little-endian, RFC 4648 base32 without padding) and decoded back by the same rules; no SDK output was used. Executed in every probe column as vector 9S10 (evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json).
